steps.en: Download kickstart.sh from get.netdata.cloud and run it on each machine
steps.zh: 下载 kickstart.sh 并在每台机器上运行

steps.en: Detects the OS, containers and running services and starts per-second collectors
steps.zh: 识别系统、容器与在跑服务，启动每秒采集器

steps.en: Stores samples in tiered dbengine, evaluates stock alerts, scores each metric for anomalies
steps.zh: 写入分层 dbengine，评估内置告警，给每个指标打异常分

steps.en: Open the node's dashboard on port 19999
steps.zh: 打开该节点 19999 端口的看板

steps.en: Serves auto-generated charts with anomaly rates, no queries or dashboard building
steps.zh: 给出自动生成的图表与异常率，不用写查询或搭看板

value.en: Per-second charts, stock alerts and anomaly flags for a machine without writing exporters, queries or dashboards
value.zh: 不写 exporter、查询和看板，就能拿到一台机器的每秒图表、内置告警和异常标记
